//: Rare finds on the things a survivor works at, beside what the thing itself gives: one roll per operation (a round of gathering or harvesting, a search, a dismantling), at most one find, never on bashing, drawing water, cutting ice or snow. Rows are keyed by a group that names its fixtures (interactables.json ids). `chance` is per operation; `band` is the loot band it must fall in (item-rarity.json lootThresholds: common from 5%, uncommon 1-5%, rare 0.1-1%, epic 0.01-0.1%, legendary under 0.01%). `note` is how the find is told. Only enabled ids are rolled; an item's loot title colour still comes from its best source anywhere (ItemRarity).
